cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. The magazine hasn't rejected your poem. They think it deserves its own booklet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They returned it. If even you think it's hopeless, I'll stop writing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. That's why they returned it. They can't give it enough space.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you write that on the cover? With your name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. 'A voice that deserves more space.' Print my name large enough for the editor to see.
